items.summary: fix(sessions): stop retrying replaced delivery endpoints on every restart (#174278) * fix(sessions): settle replaced delivery endpoints after restart Record a durable blocked-delivery notice before cancelling replay of inputs whose source or target was reset, archived, or replaced. Preserve accepted input data and all endpoint fences; leave permission and storage failures retryable. Add correlation identifiers without logging messages or raw session keys, and prove that a second recovery pass is silent. * test(sessions): preserve cancelled delivery receipt assertions * fix(sessions): preserve recovery notices during orphan repair * test(sessions): assert typed recovery context messages * fix(sessions): preserve notices at orphan rewind boundaries * test(sessions): retain fake timers for recovery persistence

items.title: perf(gateway): cut allocation hotspots under concurrent agent turns (…
items.summary: perf(gateway): cut allocation hotspots under concurrent agent turns (#174130) * perf(gateway): trim per-request and per-turn allocation hotspots Heap profiles of the gateway concurrency bench (16 sessions x 4 turns with tool events, history clients, subscribers, control plane) showed: - Control UI bootstrap and config.get rebuilt the full schema redaction lookup per request (~7% of sampled allocations). Cache it per immutable ConfigUiHints object. - Embedded attempt cleanup spread the whole attempt params per cleanup step; pass only the fields runOwnedAgentCleanup reads. - intersectSessionEventToolsAllow rebuilt a tool-policy matcher (group expansion + glob compile) for every candidate x restriction pair; build one matcher per restriction. - Tool descriptor snapshots were per session only, so every new session republished identical descriptors. Seed a session's first attempt from the latest snapshot with identical inputs; per-tool identity checks still gate every reuse. * perf(agents): skip redundant context copies on the turn path - Bootstrap file and routing resolution spread the whole embedded attempt for every call; pass the fields their callees declare. - Re-entering the current plugin execution frame still called AsyncLocalStorage.run, which copies the entire async context map; run the callback directly when the frame is already current. - Gateway scope copies built two property descriptors per key; plain enumerable-checked assignment onto the fresh scope is equivalent. * perf(agents): share descriptor publication between concurrent cold sessions Sessions that start together all miss the descriptor snapshot and each republished and prewarmed the same provider schemas at settlement. At publish time, reuse an entry another session already published when its source schema, output schema, and description identities match. * perf(gateway): stop re-deriving paths and buffers on hot read paths - The activity-summary pump rechecks every queued state and re-resolved each one's session store path; memoize store paths per config publication. - matchesAgentDatabaseReadCandidatePath resolved both paths even when they were the identical string. - SQLite worker transfers copied single-frame records into a fresh buffer before deserializing; deserialize the frame bytes directly. * refactor(gateway): keep recap store-path memo with activity-summary state Move the per-config store-path memo next to the other activity-summary scope helpers to keep the service under the file-size limit, and drop the single-frame transfer fast path: the profiled bytes were the deserialized values themselves, not the reassembly copy. * fix(gateway): address review on shared descriptors and recap store paths - Key the activity-summary store-path memo by the store setting value; config publications can mutate the same object in place. - Require a matching tool name before reusing another session's published descriptor.

items.title: test(onboard): prepare native pin state before spoofing Windows
items.summary: test(onboard): prepare native pin state before spoofing Windows PR #174228 (6e8bb0f3aebf) intentionally makes noninteractive setup record fresh-profile runtime-pin migration completion before serving. Its body states: "Profile setup and Gateway startup record the completed no-work receipt before serving". The daemon health timing fixture spoofs process.platform across setup, which sent the new real filesystem creation through Windows-only native inspection on Linux and macOS. Initialize the real migration owner before the platform spoof. Keep the production path, assertions and timeouts. The unchanged file reproduced the exact ENOTSUP failure from hourly 38916811035; the fixture correction passes all 18 cases locally.

items.title: TypeSafe擴充Jev決策模型，支援圖片判斷與物件定位
items.summary: 美國AI新創公司TypeSafe AI發布決策型AI模型Jev 1.14.0，同步開放圖片輸入與長上下文等實驗性功能。新版新增Box物件定位功能，回傳位置座標與信心分數，讓應用程式直接使用判斷結果。不過，官方提醒影像相關功能尚未達到正式環境的可靠度要求。 Jev是TypeSafe開發的決策型AI模型，與逐字生成回答的聊天模型不同，開發者提供資料與問題後，Jev會直接回傳是非判斷、分類選項或評分，並提供機率資訊，供程式決定後續動作。圖片輸入功能則讓Jev能夠分析影像內容，執行分類與比對等工作。
